retro:
# PR #12722 retrospective

## What worked

Fresh verified Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh sessions received equivalent neutral assignments. Both finals existed before either was read. Source-only Sol review and Opus native-query checks complemented the coordinator's source inspection. No finding quota was imposed. The conditional query-error disagreement was resolved explicitly without inventing consensus. Fresh Astra Medium editorial pass includes privacy.

## Avoidable friction and deviations

The first native-query fixture omitted pacman option directories and continued after setup failure. V2 repaired that setup but still used proxy path assertions, unchecked nested producers/stub writes and aggregate mismatch handling. Those omissions violated the explicit assignment despite a zero overall exit. The coordinator inspected actual fixture code and raw evidence, preserved the runs, obtained an audit addendum, and excluded broad fixture totals. Stock-test internal scratch was removed, so only outer streams survive and no stock-test total is public.

These are fixture/process defects, not confirmed review.py or Omadev bugs. No desktop tooling was used. No observed host mutation, native memory edit, peer contamination or quota event.

## Correction for future assignments

Do not reuse either fixture unchanged. Before native-query fixtures run, require a literal table with one row for every actual target and producer, including exact mkdir directories, pacman dbpath/root/cache/gpg/hook/log paths, each generated stub append/status redirect and each substitution/pipeline stage. Compare the table to the generated stubs, not only their driver. An assertion of a child/x path does not assert its mkdir parent. Pre-create all required native option directories and gate stderr-file readability, expected child status and content separately. A grep gate must distinguish no-match from tool/read failure. Stop the affected case immediately on any prerequisite, expected-status or semantic mismatch.

Native query stdout/stderr/exit and synthetic DB inputs can support individually reviewed observations even when summary predicates are invalid. Preserve and narrow evidence rather than rerunning solely for attractive pass totals. Source-only scope is preferable where a further experiment cannot change an important conclusion. Assignment-local audit-addendum.md and notes.md record the correction without native-memory changes; coordinator workflow instructions also receive this targeted correction.

## Cleanup and carry-forward

No background children, desktop slots, services or real package mutations. Private source/evidence and native history remain preserved. Future publication should recheck the exact head/discussion and checked draft hash. No next PR selected by this coordinator.
comment:
No actionable defect found in the normal migration path at `f641d86372e5`.

**Verified:** The migration selects dependency-installed Limine recovery packages on ARM systems with a Limine configuration, then marks them explicit before the update's orphan cleanup. Source inspection and real `pacman -Qqd` queries against synthetic package databases support this selection:

| Package state | Migration action |
| --- | --- |
| Installed as a dependency | Mark explicit |
| Already explicit or absent | Leave unchanged |
| Unrelated dependency | Leave unchanged |

Non-ARM systems and ARM systems without the Limine configuration are skipped. The existing migration runner records completion only after the privileged write succeeds; a failed write remains pending. Absent recovery packages are not reinstalled.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Pinned source inspection and isolated native pacman queries against synthetic databases. Privileged writes were recorded, not performed. No real ARM update, reboot or snapshot rollback was tested.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra Medium initial inspection, independent Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, followed by Astra Medium adjudication against source and retained evidence. A separate fresh Astra Medium check assessed presentation and privacy.
